title: Brush Collision Free Suggestions
description: Complete puzzle3d brush tool: engagement suggestions and commits must be collision-free. Random compatible order, probe AABB vs scene meshes (exclude host), empty placement when none free.
summary: Brush engagement suggestions and commits are now collision-free. Added shuffleBrushCompatibleCandidates, brushPreviewCollides, brushCollisionFreeCandidates, and brushPreviewMatchesCandidate in the Brush region. BrushSession shuffles compatible candidates on vortex enter, probes AABB overlap via pooled GLB meshes (host excluded), publishes only collision-free placement candidates to engagement, guards commit when colliding or empty, and reconciles when the preview ghost loads. Engagement UI shows collision-free hint and status when no placement exists. Extended vitest coverage; all 204 react tests pass.
